description: This file defines an Angular component for the customer management page, including UI elements for listing, searching, paginating, and deleting customers. It interacts with a CustomerService to fetch and modify data.

classes.name: CustomersPageComponent
classes.description: Angular component for displaying and managing a paginated list of customers, with search, refresh, and delete functionalities.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the customer list from the server, updating component state with new data or errors.

methods.name: onSearch
methods.description: Updates the search term and reloads the customer list based on the new search.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Navigates to the previous page of customer data and refreshes the list.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Navigates to the next page of customer data and refreshes the list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a customer after user confirmation and refreshes the list.

ctags.name: res
ctags.pattern: /^      const res = await this.customers.list(this.page(), this.pageSize(), this.search());$/
